description: Source code for disassembling IA-32 instructions, including opcode lookup, instruction decoding, and stack modification analysis.

methods.name: long_from_operand
methods.description: Calculates stack modification value from an operand based on its type and data.

methods.name: ia32_stack_mod
methods.description: Determines how an instruction modifies the stack.

methods.name: ia32_handle_cpu
methods.description: Sets CPU and ISA details for an instruction based on CPU flags.

methods.name: ia32_handle_mnemtype
methods.description: Handles mnemonic type and group for an instruction.

methods.name: ia32_handle_notes
methods.description: Sets note information for an instruction.

methods.name: ia32_handle_eflags
methods.description: Handles eflags effects for an instruction.

methods.name: ia32_handle_prefix
methods.description: Processes instruction prefixes and updates prefix string.

methods.name: reg_32_to_16
methods.description: Converts 32-bit register operand to 16-bit if applicable.

methods.name: ia32_decode_insn
methods.description: Decodes instruction operands and implicit operands from byte stream.

methods.name: ia32_table_lookup
methods.description: Performs opcode table lookup and handles multi-byte and extension opcodes.

methods.name: ia32_disasm_addr
methods.description: Main disassembly function that decodes an instruction at a given address.
